allowed.reason: chng: the console cheat that runs a line of game code the player typed; running typed code is the cheat.
egga/eggk: console cheats that list the values or keys of a game expression the player typed.
The config formula parser: turns a formula like (t) => t * 2 from the config file into a function.
The config page's half of the formula parser: turns the (t) => ... formulas the player edits into functions.
The Monitor tab's live channel back to the injector's own local server (core).
The Search and Monitor tabs read any path the player types, starting from the game's window (core tooling that lives in utils/).
Storagecap deposit chest: swapped for one deposit call only; a lasting proxy would have to follow every chest the game builds.
_DNprint: the actor's field is watched for one call only (set, then restored two ways), like the chest in the deposit scope.
growTo: the player's growTo is swapped while init runs, so the big model never shows at normal size.
storage.js: the chest's count fields are swapped while the game builds its digit images (set, then restored two ways).
storage.js: runLater and runPeriodically are swapped while ActorEvents_481 init schedules the storage timers.
Minigame actor proxy: catching and fishing read their state from this actor's own _GenInfo array.
Minigame actor proxy: choppin's gold zone is read from this actor's own _GeneralINFO array.
Minigame actor proxies: darts, Scratch and Wisdom Monument read their state from this actor's own _GenINFO array.

runLater: Gold Pot Rush swaps behavior.runLater for one _event_OwlEvent call, like the other per-call swaps (decided 2026-11-19).
